parties.petitioner: State of Madhya Pradesh through Principal Secretary & Ors.

summary: Dispute over applicability of UGC pay scale to librarian in Ayurvedic college under Ayush Department. Respondent claimed UGC pay scale under 1990 Rules, but court found those rules inapplicable as her post was governed by 1987 Recruitment Rules under Public Health (ISM&H) Department. Key distinctions in eligibility, pay scale, and administrative control established. Precedent in Ramesh Chandra Bajpai (2009) applied: no entitlement to UGC scale for Ayush employees. Doctrine of equal pay for equal work not applicable due to differing qualifications and recruitment criteria. High Court's order directing UGC pay scale set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Madhya Pradesh Education Service (Collegiate Branch), Recruitment Rules, 1990
Madhya Pradesh Public Health (Indian System of Medicine and Homeopathy), Class-III, Clerical and Non-Clerical Services Recruitment Rules, 1987
State of Madhya Pradesh & Ors. vs. Ramesh Chandra Bajpai, (2009) 13 SCC 635
final_judgment: Appeal allowed. Impugned judgment of High Court set aside. Respondent not entitled to UGC pay scale.
